mapper.sql: id, user_id, category, filters::text, language, requested_at, max_rows, max_bytes, retention_hours, status, expires_at, file_bytes, download_digest
mapper.select: SELECT config_key FROM app_config_entries WHERE config_key = 'sparkle.exports.pool-mib' FOR UPDATE
SELECT count(*) FROM data_export_jobs WHERE user_id = #{uid} AND quota_day = #{day} AND status <> 'FAILED'
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'READY' THEN file_bytes ELSE max_bytes END), 0) FROM data_export_jobs WHERE status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'READY')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO data_export_jobs (id, user_id, category, filters, language, request_ip, user_agent, requested_at, quota_day, status, max_rows, max_bytes, retention_hours) VALUES (#{job.id}, #{job.userId}, #{job.category}, CAST(#{job.filters} AS jsonb), #{job.language}, CAST(#{ip} AS inet), #{agent}, #{job.requestedAt}, #{day}, 'QUEUED', #{job.maxRows}, #{job.maxBytes}, #{job.retentionHours})
mapper.select: UPDATE data_export_jobs SET status = 'RUNNING', lease_until = now() + interval '30 minutes' WHERE id = ( SELECT id FROM data_export_jobs WHERE status = 'QUEUED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM data_export_jobs WHERE status = 'RUNNING') ORDER BY requested_at, id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) RETURNING
mapper.update: UPDATE data_export_jobs SET lease_until = now() + interval '30 minutes' WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_until > now()

UPDATE data_export_jobs SET status = 'READY', finished_at = now(), expires_at = #{expires}, row_count = #{rows}, file_bytes = #{bytes}, download_digest = #{digest}, truncated = #{truncated}, lease_until = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_until > now()
UPDATE data_export_jobs SET status = 'FAILED', finished_at = now(), lease_until = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_until <= now()
mapper.select: SELECT FROM data_export_jobs WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_until <= now() ORDER BY requested_at LIMIT 50
SELECT FROM data_export_jobs WHERE files_removed_at IS NULL AND (status = 'FAILED' OR (status = 'READY' AND expires_at <= now())) ORDER BY finished_at LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE data_export_jobs SET status = CASE WHEN status = 'READY' THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE status END, download_digest = NULL, files_removed_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND files_removed_at IS NULL AND (status = 'FAILED' OR (status = 'READY' AND expires_at <= now()))
mapper.select: SELECT FROM data_export_jobs WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{uid}
